name: pi-1c-agent-profile-manifest
description: Rebranding manifest for packages that resolve PI_PACKAGE_DIR - here pi-mcp-adapter. It supplies piConfig.clientUri for OAuth dynamic client registration, so registering a client never advertises a foreign URL. Do NOT add piConfig.name: pi-mcp-adapter would then resolve its agent dir from <NAME>_CODING_AGENT_DIR (uppercase, spaces kept) and PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR would stop being honoured.
